about: The XML codec's mutants, applied to the example's copy of modules/xml/xml (TestVendoredCopiesMatch keeps it the module's). Killers are the examples suite (examples:catalog: the xml package's laws and tests, and the cases); each rule names the law or test that kills it and no other law of the package does.

mutants.name: xml-item-element-renamed
mutants.rule: EncodeWritesTheForm (and the feed case): a list's values are <item> elements. The reader takes any element as a list's value, so the laws still hold.

mutants.name: xml-cdata-keeps-bracket
mutants.rule: ParserGivesEachToken: a CDATA section's token is its text as written, without <![CDATA[. Encode writes no CDATA section, so the laws still hold.

mutants.name: xml-repeated-attribute-passes
mutants.rule: MalformedIsPlaced: a start tag names each attribute once (XML 1.0, 3.1). Encode writes at most one attribute, so the laws still hold.

mutants.name: xml-doctype-not-named
mutants.rule: DocumentTypeIsRefused: a document type declaration is refused by name, so its failure says why (no entity it declares is expanded).

mutants.name: xml-depth-limit-off-by-one
mutants.rule: DepthIsLimited: MaxDepth 2 reads two nested elements and fails the third, at its start tag.

mutants.name: xml-path-index-from-one
mutants.rule: DecodeNamesTheShape (and the shape case): a path's index counts a parent's elements from 0. No law reads a path.

mutants.name: xml-float-read-as-float32
mutants.rule: RoundTrips: a float64 reads back as itself. Every text still reads, and NumbersAtTheirEdges' 0.5 is a float32, so only the round trip sees it.

mutants.name: xml-control-character-written
mutants.from:
} else if c < 0x20 && c != '\t' && c != '\n' {
				rep = "\uFFFD"
mutants.rule: OutputIsWellFormed: a control character XML cannot hold is written as U+FFFD. RoundTrips draws only texts XML holds, so it still holds.

mutants.name: xml-control-character-read
mutants.from:
if c < 0x20 && c != '\t' && c != '\n' && c != '\r' {
				return At(text, i, "a control character")
mutants.to:
if c < 0x01 && c != '\t' && c != '\n' && c != '\r' {
				return At(text, i, "a control character")
mutants.rule: ControlCharacterIsRejectedWhereItIs: XML holds no control character but tab, line feed and carriage return. Encode never writes one.

mutants.name: xml-unended-tag-past-the-text
mutants.from: At(p.text, len(p.text), "the start tag <"+name+" does not end")
mutants.to: At(p.text, len(p.text)+1, "the start tag <"+name+" does not end")
mutants.rule: TruncationIsRejectedInsideTheText: a document cut inside a start tag fails at an offset inside the text it was given.

mutants.name: catalog-draft-not-retirable
mutants.from:
case (Draft, Retire), (Listed, Retire), (SoldOut, Retire):
		Enter[Status]{Next: Retired}
mutants.to:
case (Listed, Retire), (SoldOut, Retire):
		Enter[Status]{Next: Retired}
	case (Draft, Retire):
		Reject
mutants.rule: Listing.AlwaysRetirable: every listing the shop can reach, a draft too, can be retired.

mutants.name: catalog-feed-too-shallow
mutants.rule: Feed.ReadsBack: the feed reads every catalog it publishes, whose items' tags nest five elements deep.
